mainCharacter.name: Hank
mainCharacter.role: Main character; a stout, kind harbor pilot boat
mainCharacter.color: Navy blue hull with a creamy white cabin, pale yellow cabin light, and soft red bumper trim
mainCharacter.bodyShape: Short stout pilot boat with a rounded bow, snug cabin, soft rubber bumpers, and no arms or hands
mainCharacter.face: Large calm blue windshield eyes and a gentle smile on the bow
mainCharacter.wheels: No wheels; floats on water with a small cream wake
mainCharacter.accessories: Pale yellow cabin roof light, silver railings, a coiled soft rope on the deck, and tiny navy life rings on each side

Dot.color: Sunny yellow hull with white seats and sky-blue trim
Dot.bodyShape: Tiny rounded dinghy with no arms or hands
Dot.face: Round green eyes on the bow and a cheerful little smile
Dot.accessories: A small cream paddle rest and a pale blue bow fender
Dot.role: Supporting character; a small sunny dinghy friend

Dock Float.role: Supporting prop; a soft harbor float that drifted loose

setting.Moonlit Harbor: A calm vehicle harbor with wooden docks, soft pilings, warm pier lanterns, gentle waves, and a quiet boat shed
setting.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded forms, clean single-scene compositions, gentle harbor evening colors, and no readable text

style: Warm polished 3D children's animation illustration, bright friendly lighting, soft rounded forms, true 4:3 landscape single continuous scene. NO text, letters, numbers, badges, logos, watermarks, panels, collage, grid, comic layout, contact sheet, or multi-panel. Vehicles have NO arms, hands, or human limbs. Leave the bottom 25-30% of the frame as soft uncluttered ground/space so a narration panel can overlay later; keep all important subjects above the lower quarter.
continuityRules: Hank keeps the same navy-and-white colors, pale yellow cabin light, blue windshield eyes, soft red bumpers, silver railings, coiled rope, and life rings on every page.
Hank and every boat/vehicle have no human-like arms or hands; help is done with gentle hull bumps and the soft rope.
Dot remains a tiny sunny yellow dinghy with green bow eyes and sky-blue trim.
The dock float is red-and-white; its cream line is loose on Pages 4-9 and secured by Page 11.
The wooden dock and pier lanterns match across pages; water stays calm and bedtime-safe.
The sky progresses from golden evening to lavender dusk, blue twilight, and moonlit night.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, contact sheet, text, badge, logo, or watermark.
